soumya: Heads up — saw a spike in 5xxs when preemptible nodes evicted long-lived streaming sessions. tokens rotate and clients hit auth errors mid-stream.
jon: Can you repro locally or only in staging? which pool?
soumya: Repro on staging + a small canary in prod. Mixed preemptible pool (g4dn-like). Steps: start a streaming request, evict the node, new node issues a rotated token and connection gets transient auth failures.
sylvia: Ugh. Two immediate ideas: 1) buffer + replay active streams during drain, 2) accept old token for a short overlap window while cutover completes.
infra-bot: deploy-bot: evict-mitigations v0.14 deployed to staging (sha: a1b2c3) :rocket:
soumya: Proposed runtime behavior sketch: on EVICT signal, mark connection draining but keep accepting requests and tokens for a grace window, buffer in-flight stream frames and attempt replay to a compatible node. Minimal config prototype: ```json
{
  "drain_mode": true,
  "drain_accept_window_ms": 45000,
  "stream_requeue_policy": "buffer_and_replay",
  "token_dual_accept": true
}
```
jon: Two concerns: memory and fairness. If many streams buffer, we could OOM. Need per-node limits: max_buffered_streams and a backpressure policy (reject oldest or reject new). Also add a per-stream byte cap.
sylvia: Agreed. Also add observability signals: buffered_streams_count, replay_attempts_total, replay_success_ratio, replay_latency_p95. If replay_latency_p95 > 2s or replay_success_ratio < 95% for 1m, fallback to redirect behavior (307) to avoid cascading queues.
alex: :thumbsup: Can you put this in a short RFC and include an experiment plan? I'd like a 10% canary on preemptible traffic first.
soumya: Will draft RFC. Metrics planned: runtime.streams.buffered, runtime.streams.replayed, runtime.streams.dropped_reasons. Adding backpressure config: max_buffered_streams=200, per_stream_max_bytes=4MB, drain_accept_window_ms adjustable.
jon: After staging pass, let's run a canary tomorrow at 22:00 UTC and monitor the new metrics + overall 5xx rate. @infra-bot can you schedule canary?
infra-bot: Canary scheduled: evict-mitigations v0.14 -> 10% of preemptible pool on 2026-04-02T22:00:00Z.
sylvia: Also thinking about client-side improvements: short-lived edge tokens that can be renewed without full reconnect for mobile SDKs — reduces need for replay in many cases. Add to RFC appendix.
soumya: Notes added to the RFC draft. I'll ping once it's ready for review. Thanks everyone!
